value.label: SYNTHETIC submitted feedback: admin-shaped pages and PROPOSED export contract, not verified live responses

parameters.content:
## Submitted feedback demonstration

Manual only. Demo inputs are synthetic admin-shaped submitted pages and a PROPOSED feedback export. This does not read pending lists or submit new feedback. Raw comments are reduced to a boolean. Rules and thresholds come from student-tracker/config.yaml; regenerate this export after changing them.

Attach a credential for a disposable DEMO Postgres database with the student-tracker schema. Database failures stop the visible manual run after retries. No Alcovia API is called. Unknown evidence is reported, not invented. Demo summary shows rejected rows. This does not update live pipeline freshness.
